description: Kaufland receipt copy (PDF with a text layer): section headers, multi-quantity and weighed lines, deposit, carrier bag, packaging voucher and a 3-rate VAT table.
notes: Printed TOTAL is 208,79; the 20,00 packaging voucher is a payment-side deduction, so paidBani is 188,79.
Section headers (Alimente, Băuturi alcoolice, ...) become storeCategoryHint of the lines under them, including the deposit line.
unitPriceBani only where a unit price is printed (`3 * 5,19`); single-quantity and weighed lines print the line total only.
Sizes are glued to names (`ROSII DEPELATE425ML`, `VDR SMANTANA400G`); `OETKER ZAH.VAN8G*4` is a 4-pack of 8 g, so pack = 32 g.
The loyalty-card row and the card slip after the VAT table are masked (letters x, digits 0): a parser must ignore them.
documentNo is a fake of the printed receipt number; branch.code is the printed store number; till and cashier are masked.
